genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-07. This scope assessment concerns the DUSD Machine Token, whose share price varies with strategy accounting and whose issuer does not undertake fixed-value redemption. Sections 4.e and 4.f of the Machine Terms exclude EU/EEA and U.S.-person acquisition orders respectively. Those territorial restrictions are separate from GENIUS authorization. No GENIUS authorization or securities-law exemption is asserted; underlying USDC approvals and disclosures are not inherited.
